seo.description: OpenSpace is an open-source website builder: designer templates, a visual editor and Claude, on a site you own and host free on GitHub Pages.
seo.title: A professional website you own, free to host

fields.text: A professional website that's yours to keep

content.text: Start from a designer template, shape it in a visual editor or with Claude, and publish it free on GitHub Pages. Every page is a plain file in your own GitHub repository.

fields.label: Start free
fields.note: Open source and in pre-release. You need a free GitHub account.

fields.subheading: Website builders charge every month for hosting that is now free. Here is three years on each builder's cheapest plan that does the job, at their published annual prices.

content.text: What OpenSpace costs you: nothing for hosting on GitHub Pages, or on your own Cloudflare account, which has a free plan. A domain name costs the same wherever you buy it (builders include the first year with an annual plan). Card payments go through your own Stripe account at Stripe's usual rates, as they would anywhere, and OpenSpace adds no fee on top.

fields.title: Three years of website plans, in US dollars
fields.description: The cheapest plan with a custom domain, and the cheapest that sells with no platform fee, at published annual prices.

fields.text: And what you can take with you
fields.subheading: Price isn't the only cost. If you leave a builder, here is what comes along, according to each one's own help pages.

content.text: Exports some pages and one blog as a WordPress file. Styles, custom CSS, store pages and most blocks stay behind.
A Wix site can't be moved to another host or backed up outside Wix. Blog posts can't be exported.
Code export needs a paid Workspace plan, and leaves out CMS, ecommerce and user content. Forms and search stop working.
Everything. Your site is already a repository in your account, and form entries, subscribers and orders export as spreadsheets.

Prices are in US dollars per month billed annually, before tax, read from each company's pricing page on 27 October 2026; monthly billing costs more on every builder. Squarespace Basic adds a 2% fee on store sales and Webflow's Standard ecommerce plan ($29) adds 2%, which is why the selling comparison uses the next plan up. Sources:

fields.text: Work on your site with Claude
fields.subheading: Claude doesn't write HTML for you to maintain. It edits your site through the same typed operations as Studio, checks its work and keeps it reversible.

items.title: Validated edits only
items.text: Every change is a typed operation. An invalid edit is refused with the reason, and nothing changes.

items.title: Undo everything
items.text: A snapshot is taken before Claude's first edit, and edits land in a draft until you publish.

items.title: Design check and screenshots
items.text: Claude checks contrast, headings and layout, applies one-click fixes and looks at the page at 1440, 834 and 390 px.

items.title: Your Claude, your account
items.text: OpenSpace never runs or meters an AI model. Claude uses your own Claude plan.

content.text: Claude Code:
/plugin marketplace add omniharmonic/openspace
, then
/plugin install openspace
A site in Studio:
claude mcp add --transport http openspace https://hub.openspace.host/mcp

fields.subheading: Squarespace-class features, built as open source. The store, member areas and password pages need your site on your own Cloudflare account, and selling needs a Stripe account.

items.title: Visual editor
items.text: Click to edit, drag and resize on a 24-column grid, layer blocks, and arrange the phone layout separately.

items.title: Templates and sections
items.text: Twenty templates in three looks, and 277 designed section presets that take on your site's style.

items.title: Site Styles
items.text: Palettes, 33 font pairings, buttons, spacing and corners. A contrast solver keeps every color pair readable.

items.title: Design check
items.text: Finds weak contrast, skipped headings, missing alt text and crowded layouts, with one-click fixes.

items.title: Collaboration
items.text: Edit together in real time. Invite owners, designers, editors and contributors, and lock sections.

items.title: Edit from your phone
items.text: Change words and photos, add sections and publish from Studio on a phone.

items.title: History and scheduling
items.text: Roll back to any published version, and schedule a publish or a blog post for later.

items.title: Forms and inbox
items.text: Contact and sign-up forms with spam protection, email notifications and CSV export.

items.title: Newsletter and campaigns
items.text: Double opt-in sign-ups, then email campaigns built from your site's own blocks.

items.title: Private analytics
items.text: Visits and sources without cookies or tracking. Counts are aggregated and anonymous.

items.title: Store and donations
items.text: Products, variants, inventory, shipping and donations through Stripe Checkout. Cloudflare only.

items.title: Members and passwords
items.text: Members-only areas with free or paid tiers, and password pages. Cloudflare only.

items.title: Your own domain
items.text: A wizard finds your registrar, shows the exact DNS records and checks them until HTTPS is on.

items.title: Blog, events and more
items.text: Posts with RSS, events with calendar files, portfolios and podcast feeds.

items.title: Fast and findable
items.text: Static pages with sitemaps, structured data and share images. Templates score 99 to 100 on Lighthouse.

items.title: Accessible by default
items.text: Every template's home page passes automated WCAG checks in every look, with no serious issues.

fields.subheading: Each one arrives finished, with real-feeling pages and a type pairing chosen for its subject. Switch looks any time without touching your content.

fields.text: If OpenSpace disappeared tomorrow, your site would keep working
fields.subheading: That's the test we design for. Nothing about your site lives only with us.

items.title: Files in your own GitHub account
items.text: Plain JSON content, your media and an Astro site kit, under your name.

items.title: Hosted by GitHub Pages or your Cloudflare
items.text: Your accounts, your free plans. Nobody can switch your site off for not paying.

items.title: Built by standard tools
items.text: Any Node setup can build it, with or without Studio or the Hub.

items.title: Open source, top to bottom
items.text: MIT for templates and packages, AGPL for Studio and the Hub, CC BY for docs and designs. Anyone can run their own Hub.

content.text: Something else? Ask on GitHub, where the whole project happens in the open.

Not quite: OpenSpace is pre-release. Studio, the templates, the CLI and the Claude plugin work today. The connections to GitHub, Cloudflare, Stripe and email providers are built and tested against stand-ins, and some haven't yet run against the live services, so treat a business-critical site as an early adopter would.

Hosting is, because your site runs on GitHub Pages or your own Cloudflare account. The shared Hub, which handles forms, newsletters and analytics, is free with fair-use limits, such as 1,000 form entries a month per site. Anyone can run their own Hub.

items.question: Do I need to know code or GitHub?

content.text: No. You need a free GitHub account, and Studio walks you through making one. After that you edit visually; words like repository and commit stay in Settings, under Advanced.
Nothing extra from OpenSpace. Claude works on your site with your own Claude account. OpenSpace never runs an AI model, so it has nothing to meter.

items.question: Can I sell things or run a members area?

content.text: Yes, with your site on your own Cloudflare account and payments through your own Stripe account. OpenSpace takes no cut; Stripe charges its usual card fees.

items.question: Can I use my own domain?

content.text: Yes. Buy one from any registrar, and the domain wizard shows the exact records to add and checks them until HTTPS is on.
Any time, and you take it all. Your site is already a repository in your account that standard tools build, and your form entries, subscribers and orders export as CSV.

fields.text: Make a website you'll never have to rent
